name: regression-tool-call-identity
goal: Pair unchanged regression runs across separate Codex tool calls while retaining meaningful environment settings.

evidence: Two current tool calls changed only CODEX_TOOL_CALL_ID in the relevant profile: full hashes differed while hashes with that identifier omitted matched.
The existing environment profile case covers launcher and resource lease identities but omits the per-tool-call identifier; extend that same case without adding tests.
